## PR 483

**Image-to-video engine — part 2 (V1 C8.6 item 3)**

**বাংলায়:** চাওয়া ক্লিপ এখন "সারিতে দিন" আর "চালান" চেপে সত্যিকারের ভিডিও ইঞ্জিনে পাঠানো যায়; ব্যর্থ হলে সর্বোচ্চ ৩ বার "আবার চেষ্টা করুন"। আসল প্রোভাইডার এখনো নেই, তাই ফলাফল সৎ একটা প্রিভিউ (প্রোডাক্টের নিজের ছবি)।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-11
  - Build status row: image-to-video engine — part 2, job orchestration (S25, CN-039; Blueprint C8.2; no registry change, no migration): `@extas/creative-studio`'s `video.ts` gains `queueVideoJob` (`DRAFT` → `QUEUED`), `runVideoJob` (`QUEUED` → `PROCESSING`, calls the provider's `createClip` once, lands on `REVIEW_REQUIRED` on success or `FAILED` on a provider refusal — never throws past a refusal, the job's own status and the audit log carry the outcome) and `retryVideoJob` (`FAILED` → `QUEUED` with one more `attempt`, `CAP_REACHED` past `MAX_ATTEMPTS` — a technical bound of 3, the same "no more automatic tries" shape PR 309's spend cap uses for money, here for attempts); every move off its proper state is `WRONG_STATE`. Marketing › Studio › Videos: each job row gets its own next-move button — "Queue it" on a waiting clip, "Run it" on a queued one, "Retry" (with its attempt count) on a failed one up to the cap — each move re-reads the page. No real video provider is connected yet, so a run still lands on the mock's honest preview (the source still itself, `practice: true`); review/approve from `REVIEW_REQUIRED` and best-of-2 are PR 484.
  - GitHub pull request #135, 11 Nov

## PR 484

**Image-to-video engine — part 3 (V1 C8.6 item 4)**

**বাংলায়:** সেটিংসে "বেস্ট-অফ-২" চালু করলে প্রতিটা ক্লিপ দুইবার বানিয়ে ভালোটা রাখা হবে, খরচ দ্বিগুণ হবে। "যাচাই দরকার" ক্লিপ এখন এই পাতা থেকেই অনুমোদন বা বাতিল করা যায়।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-11
  - Build status row: image-to-video engine — part 3, best-of-2 and review/approve (S25, CN-039; Blueprint C8.2; registry v289 `studio.video` adds `bestOfTwo`, off — CN-018 off-by-default perk; v288 was taken by PR 447's registry-photoshoot.ts, merged first; no migration): `@extas/adapters`'s video contract gains an optional `passes` on `VideoEstimateInput` (`estimateFromRate` multiplies by it, default 1) and an optional `score` on `VideoClipResult` (the mock never sets one); `@extas/creative-studio`'s `video.ts` gains `BEST_OF_PASSES` (2, a technical constant, not CN-018's business number) and reads `studio.video.bestOfTwo` in `estimateVideoJob`/`requestVideoJob` (the quote is already doubled, never a surprise after the fact) and in `runVideoJob`, which now runs `BEST_OF_PASSES` passes — always, not only as a retry-on-failure — and keeps the `SUCCEEDED` pass with the higher `score` (ties, and every pass against the mock, keep the first that succeeded); `actualMinor` bills the single-pass rate × the passes actually run either way. `approveVideoJob`/`rejectVideoJob` move a `REVIEW_REQUIRED` job to `APPROVED`/`REJECTED`, `WRONG_STATE` from anywhere else; `VideoJobView` gains `providerJobId`/`actualMinor` (a pre-existing gap — PR 482/483 stored them but never surfaced them). Marketing › Studio › Videos: a `REVIEW_REQUIRED` row gets "Approve"/"Reject" buttons, and a run's actual cost shows once it has one; admin guide updated. Reel assembly with the approved clips is PR 485/486.
  - GitHub pull request #179, 12 Nov

## PR 486

**Reel assembly — part 2 (V1 C8.6 item 6)**

**বাংলায়:** রিল "জোড়া লাগান" চাপলে প্রতিটা বাছা মাপের জন্য একটা আউটপুট বসে। আসল ভিডিও কম্পোজিটর এখনো নেই, তাই আউটপুট একটা সৎ প্রিভিউ (অনুমোদিত ক্লিপের নিজের ফাইল), আসল জোড়া-লাগানো ভিডিও নয়।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-12
  - Build status row: reel assembly — part 2, the actual compositor (S25, CN-039; Blueprint C8.1, C8.6 item 6; no registry change, no migration): `@extas/creative-studio`'s `reel.ts` gains `assembleReel`, which moves a `DRAFT` (or previously `FAILED`) reel's status to `ASSEMBLED` and fills `Reel.outputAssetIds` — one per chosen aspect. No real video encoder exists yet (the same honest gap PR 439/482 set), so nothing is actually stitched, mixed or baked in: the output is the **first named clip's own already-approved real output asset** (`VideoJob.outputAssetId`), reused for every chosen shape — a real, already-existing file, never fabricated footage or a pretend per-shape crop; falls back to the next clip in order when an earlier one has no output yet. Re-checks every clip is still of this store and still `APPROVED` (`NOT_FOUND`/`CLIPS_NOT_READY`, the same codes `buildReel` uses — a clip's review can never be assumed still good) and, when music was chosen, that it is still a real audio asset of this store (`NOT_FOUND`/`SOURCE_INVALID`); refuses a set-aside reel (`WRONG_STATE` — bring it back first) or one already `ASSEMBLED` (`WRONG_STATE` — never redone silently); lands `FAILED` (never throws) when none of the clips has a usable output yet, and a `FAILED` reel may be tried again once one does, with no attempt cap (this reads data only, it never calls a provider or spends money, unlike `retryVideoJob`'s capped retries). Marketing › Studio › Reels: a `DRAFT` or `FAILED` row gets an "Assemble this reel" button; once `ASSEMBLED` the row shows a note that the output is a preview, not a real stitched video. `marketing.studio.write`; admin guide and both message files updated. 9 new `.db.test.ts` cases (real PostgreSQL, skip-safe without `TEST_DATABASE_ADMIN_URL`): assembling fills one output per shape from the first clip's own real output, falls back to the next clip when the first has none, lands `FAILED` with no usable output, a `FAILED` reel can be tried again once a clip has one, refuses a second assembly of an already-`ASSEMBLED` reel, refuses an archived reel, refuses a clip that stopped being `APPROVED` since drafting, refuses a music track that stopped being valid since drafting, refuses an unknown reel id.
  - GitHub pull request #179, 12 Nov

## PR 488

**Campaign creative export — part 2 (V1 C8.6 item 8)**

**বাংলায়:** "এই এক্সপোর্ট তৈরি করুন" চাপলে প্রতিটা বাছা মাপের জন্য একটা প্রিভিউ আউটপুট বসে — সিলেকশনের প্রথম অনুমোদিত ছবি/ভিডিওর নিজের ফাইল, একটা সৎ প্রিভিউ মাত্র। অনুমোদিত ছবি সরে গেলে "তৈরি করা যায়নি" অবস্থায় যায়, পরে আবার চেষ্টা করা যায়।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-12
  - Build status row: campaign creative export — part 2, the producer (S25, CN-039; Blueprint C8.1, C8.5, C8.6 item 7; no registry change, no migration): `@extas/creative-studio`'s `export.ts` gains `produceCreativeExport`, called on a `DRAFT` or previously-`FAILED` export (`WRONG_STATE` on any other status, including a second attempt on an already-`READY` one — `assembleReel`/`retryVideoJob`'s own "never throws on a stale selection, just lands the terminal failure status, retry freely" shape). It never trusts the request-time check: it re-reads the selection's first approved (non-archived) `ProductMedia` asset fresh, at production time. Found, it fills one output per chosen platform size, every one that same real asset's own file — the honest preview PR 439/482/485/486/487 already set, never a real crop, overlay or ad-account send (no crop engine in the stack yet) — and the row moves to `READY`. Not found (the selection's approved media moved since the request), the row moves to `FAILED` instead of throwing, with no attempt cap, so producing again once new media is approved just re-runs the same check. Marketing › Studio › Export: a `DRAFT` or `FAILED` row now shows "Produce this export" (`{action: 'produce', exportId}`, `marketing.studio.write`); a `READY` row shows a plain note that this is a preview, not a real sized ad file; `FAILED` keeps its "Produce this export" retry button and a `DRAFT` row keeps its cancel button alongside it. Admin guide `docs/admin-guide/pages/marketing/studio-export.md` updated for the produce step. 6 new `.db.test.ts` cases (real PostgreSQL, run against a live `TEST_DATABASE_ADMIN_URL` this session, 25/25 in the file, 83/83 in the package): produces READY with the right outputAssetIds from the first media by sort order; lands FAILED, never throws, when the media is archived before production; a FAILED export can be retried once media exists again, no cap; refuses a second produce on an already-READY export; refuses producing a CANCELLED export; refuses an unknown export id.
  - GitHub pull request #179, 12 Nov
